challenge.method: Read the same commit's src/jvm/clojure/lang/LazySeq.java lines 47–107 and inspect realization through seq(), the memoized field, and what happens when user code throws.
challenge.results: The constructor wraps a thunk, and seq() forces realization when needed and returns the stored sequence. The thunk is cleared after its invocation completes normally, so failed evaluation does not supply a result to cache and can be retried. The claim describes successful deferred realization and caching.

limitations: Pinned JVM macro documentation for an individual successful realization. Other forcing routes and failure behavior have separate details.
